lede: The biggest item this week is the San Miguel County BOCC special meeting Wednesday, where commissioners will take up Resolution 2026-34 — a change to Area Median Income limits on deed-restricted properties in Pinion Park that could reshape who qualifies for local workforce housing. Ridgway's Town Council also meets Wednesday with real weight on its agenda, including ratifying support for a federal Major Disaster Declaration tied to the Gold Mountain Fire, which has burned nearly 40,000 acres and repeatedly cut off Highway 550. The county Planning Commission meets Thursday to weigh in on Land Use Code amendments touching forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal energy.

notable.stake: Council ratifies disaster declaration support for 40,000-acre Gold Mountain Fire fallout.
